svg.text: y26n_humanshaped_v2 @640 — threshold vs recall & precision, fp32 vs two INT8 exports · any person (class-merged)
Spotlight-val (4,232 images) · 8,035 GT boxes · IoU ≥ 0.5 · real FP-based precision · offline replay of the floor-0.001 raw dumps (vlm-cluster/pr_curve.py, 0.01 grid)
INT8 W8A8 TFLite: max |Δrecall| 12.6 pts, max |Δprecision| 10.3 pts over thr 0.05–0.86; @0.45 Δrecall -1.0, Δprecision -2.0
INT8 + float decode ops (fix): max |Δrecall| 11.3 pts, max |Δprecision| 2.5 pts over thr 0.05–0.73; @0.45 Δrecall +0.1, Δprecision -0.3
INT8 confidences sit on a coarse ladder (int8 class-logit tensor, ≈0.3 logits/step) and stop at a ceiling; above it the export returns no boxes.
